description: v2.2.9 (pre-release, re-cut #2 — supersedes the earlier v2.2.9 asset): resolves all open issues. #22 Amazon India patching error — AMOLED resource pass now writes only android: framework attributes with a hard guard (Google Photos AMOLED patch carried the identical defect and received the same fix). #21 Amazon India video ads — NEW 'Amazon: Stop feed video autoplay' scoped patch (universal setPlayWhenReady heuristic, off by default) alongside docs/AMAZON.md with enable instructions and reach limits. #5 Mereframe 0.8.4 — 'Bypass native integrity checks' rewritten: the session wrapper now calls the native method inside a REAL JVM try/catch in the extension (MereframeIntegrityHook) instead of inline smali whose .catch was silently dropped; 'Spoof install source' Layer 2 now resolves the Application family by walking the superclass chain (androidx parents like LifecycleProcess no longer missed); 'Spoof app signature' SignatureHookApp presence is now enforced by the bundle verifier (verify_android_bundle.py asserts all 13 extension classes survive in every DEX payload incl. nested extension.mpe). Reddit v2.2.9 content unchanged (Layer 3 constant return-void kill, Layer 5 kept ON by decision, Reddit: Diagnostic crash log). No device verification yet. Latest full release remains v2.2.4.
